how: We read the website of every Pittsburgh wedding videographer listed on Lazo (66 listings, 51 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: a recording studio, a VHS-to-DVD conversion service, DJ companies with video as a line item, and photographers who do not film; only four dedicated wedding film studios surfaced, so photo-and-video teams fill out the list. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Is audio from the vows and toasts recorded on lapel mics and a board feed, or just the camera?
How long until the highlight film and the full-length edit arrive, and are raw files included?
How do you handle low light in an old hall or a barn on a short winter day, and the drive between a church and a reception across town?

picks.name: Just Hitched Wedding Films
picks.blurb: Established in 2012, Just Hitched is a wedding videography team of Ariella, Dana, Kylee and their filmmakers, serving Pittsburgh and Baltimore with cinematic storytelling. The site counts more than 250 couples and Knot recognition nine years running.

picks.name: Legacy Films
picks.blurb: Legacy Films Pittsburgh, based in Saltsburg, keeps it minimal and intentionally simple, with an Essentials package and a limited offer for wedding dates through December 2026. Booking takes a signed contract and a 25% retainer, with the balance due 30 days before the wedding.

picks.name: TYL Video
picks.blurb: Documentary storytelling with a cinematic touch, from a Pittsburgh filmmaker who also shoots photography. No stiff poses or awkward pauses, just a 90 to 120 minute film of your day, with package pricing printed on the site for the tri-state area.

picks.name: Arredondo Films
picks.blurb: Luxury wedding photography and videography in Pittsburgh and beyond, from a filmmaker who takes only 15 weddings a year so he can learn each couple's story before picking up a camera. Films built around the moments in the spaces between everything else.

picks.name: Carly Ferraco Photography
picks.blurb: Pittsburgh photographer Carly Ferraco offers videography alongside her light, bright and candid photography, so one team covers weddings, engagements and surprise proposals across greater Western Pennsylvania.

picks.name: Portraits By Sean
picks.blurb: Candid, unscripted documentation without intrusion, from a Pittsburgh studio available nationwide. Portraits by Sean sells photography and film together in two simple packages, so couples who want both can book one vendor.

picks.name: Loyalty Weddings & Events
picks.blurb: Loyal and Nicole Martinez run a woman- and minority-owned, LGBTQ+ allied company offering DJ services, photography, videography and photo booths to Pittsburgh and Ohio, a one-stop option for couples who want their vendors to work as one team.

picks.name: All-Stars Events
picks.blurb: A North Huntingdon collective of wedding DJs, photographers, videographers and photo booth rentals. All-Stars says it is not a booking agency: its members are fully insured and you know which professionals you are working with from the first contact.
